common.scope: NEW authorship in this return applies only to the five listed identities. Preserve each complete native card/class-access envelope unchanged, including blocked source status and operational=null. common.casting: Ordinary Action,120ft,V/S/F,rank8/base21RP, native class rank/level/school rows exactly. Require actual acquisition/book/preparation, available Action, components, perception, line of effect, lawful target and full occupied-volume fit. A focus must actually be accessible and S a free hand or an actual exception; V audible speech. No unprinted material price or generic Overcast. Known failure rejects before commitment; hidden later failure consumes a legally committed cast without replacement targets or revealing hidden facts. Range refers to the chosen origin; the whole created body/structure must also have actually known legal space and unobstructed formation, never intersect a creature or existing solid.
common.payment: Read Dissonance before casting. Limit=max(4,2+PB+max(0,casting modifier)); ranked costs gain+1/+2/+3 at limit/limit+3/limit+6; ordinary rank1+ blocked at limit+6 absent a real specific traumatic exception. Commit actual costs and Action once. Ordinary rank6–9 baseD2,rank1–5 baseD1,rank0 baseD0; successive same-family casts add Refrain1/2/3 capped3; different family resets to0, idle/weapon turns do not. Wizard first distinct prepared family in an encounter waives baseD only, not Refrain. Native pet actions, healing waves, weapon operation and maintenance are not new spell casts. New parent concentration ends old owner concentration at commitment before counter/outcome; no refund or restoration on failure. Shifting Fortress is expressly nonconcentration.
common.checks: Actual spell attacks d20+PB+actual casting modifier; source-specific modifiers only. Natural1 misses,natural20 hits and doubles dice only. Saves DC8+PB+modifier and actual save proficiency/conditions. Current passive defenses, cover and reaction scopes remain exact. Use real Counterspell/dispel acquisition, range, paid cost and check, not names or guessed ranks. Ordinary Wizard class Counterspell is automatic at2,rank1,cost3RP,recharge2,Reaction,60ft,INT+PB versus10+2*targetrank. Wizard class Dispel remains rank3/printed3RP/check10+targetrank; no conversion to acquired Greater Dispel.
common.ready: Accepted Ready exception: preparation spends actual Action/cost/components/strain once, starts held concentration and exposes the counter window then. Choose legal target/placement/form/operator list at release and revalidate before spending one Reaction. Invalid/declined occurrences may wait until next regular own-turn START; no refund. Release creates no second cast,cadence or counter window. Its effect duration starts at manifestation. A concentration parent continues the hold; otherwise the Ready hold ends after resolution. No structure can be placed through occupants to provide free boarding.
common.clocks: Use original regular START/END markers and stable phase/application sequence. Absolute expiry wins before new events at equality. Existing clocks keep virtual6second markers through initiative changes, extra turns, absence or death; do not multiply opportunities. Source-ending and damage-root callbacks finish under their actual causal order. Five-round Shifting Fortress has the explicit source-START convention below, not a substituted60seconds.
common.geometryAndCustody: Bodies have actual whole-body boxes/poses and mass, not point placeholders. Use actual sight versus location versus LoE; no ray through opaque solid solely because an origin is visible. Every real item retains unique ID,owner,custody,weight,Load,condition and charges. Intrinsic conjured gear/ammunition is not transferable stock. Real carried cargo settles at its actual location on ending, or records a real pending placement if no lawful support exists; no teleport to a former anchor. Unsupported real bodies/cargo use accepted Falling: start now; first descent at END of enclosing regular slot next round, or most recent completed slot if between turns, then6second steps up to300ft. Impact min(10,floor(uncontrolledDistance/20))d6,positive actual damage causes Prone. No invented crushing or free slow fall.
common.ownership: Store creator,parent source,current controller,actual acting body and damage/healing dealer separately. Companion damage belongs to the pet; actual structure weapon damage belongs to its firing operator, not building/creator. Root Null flag samples that actual dealer at creation; transfers inherit and later independent attacks create new roots. Objects still take ordinary object damage under Null. No corpse, XP,loot,RP,water,ingredient,harvest or class-proc farm follows from these creations. Actual independent source exceptions retain their own narrow scope.
common.holds: All absent actual faction/champion/profile, physical geometry/material/support, equipment/weapon proficiency, source access, healing/repair eligibility and topology facts remain whole-case or branch holds. New finite spell profiles and numbers below are explicitly authored specifications, not recovered bestiary/building content or positive campaign examples. A conditional fixture does not discharge its hold.

companionRules.countAndDuration: One body of this exact spell per original caster, across controllers; successful replacement ends the old same-spell body. All three creature parents require concentration and one absolute manifestation+60seconds deadline. Old parent concentration ends on new concentration commitment even if the replacement fails. Caster death/incapacity ends parent concentration by its actual source; ordinary0HP,expiry,voluntary creator concentration-ending/dismissal or actual removal ends the body with no corpse/loot. Lasting real cargo remains.
companionRules.command: NEW explicitly extend the AC6 attached companion schedule and lower Water support accounting to these three bodies. One owner Bonus Action command during an actual regular turn,within60ft and with actual audible speech/perception/LoE, selects one body,finite route and one available Action. It executes once immediately after the entire owner turn, rechecking capability/range/target/LoE. Command expires at the END of that attached phase if impossible,suppressed,unaffordable or budget-starved; no banking,replay,retarget or refund. No autonomous spell/drain/heal/attack without command. All owner assets share one BA-command and one damaging/control/support Action allowance per numbered round; heal,child cast,channel maintenance,native drain and strike each consume that same allowance. Extra turns do not reset it. Creation gives no free Action, but an otherwise unspent creation-turn BA may command the actual attached phase. A command may instead buy Dash/Disengage/Search/defensive movement/Dodge; no automatic Help,grapple,shove,Opportunity Attack,Ready,item activation or extra Reaction.
companionRules.defaultAndAuthority: Without a command, one source-attached defensive movement up to current Speed and Dodge at that regular opportunity, only while capable and actual space is legal; no offensive/support effect. Intrinsic physical gripping allows only genuinely possible ordinary pickup/drop with an actual available interaction in that phase, not extra work/proficiency/item activation. A source-qualified controller transfer cancels pending old orders, preserves original owner-wide spent ledgers and source clock, grants no fresh turn, and adopts only the exact new controller source schedule. Without such a source, no takeover is granted. Original source statistics retain their defined provenance.
companionRules.healingAndNull: NEW named extension of AC4/AC5/AC6 mechanical living-ally HP eligibility to Greater Water Pet,Archlich Shade and Faction Paragon only, while their finite body exists. Ordinary healing must still actually target them and respect source exclusions,prohibitions,Critical/max limits and modifiers; no biology/soul/resurrection/disease/repair entitlement. Qualifying Null damage at0 leaves the same NullDisabled0 body: Incapacitated,Speed0,no commands/Actions/BA/Reaction,original deadline/concentration continue. Later qualifying Null hits do not recreate or kill it. Actual legal healing above0 restores the same body without clock/budget refresh. Ordinary non-Null0 ends the finite body; independent expiry/removal still ends NullDisabled.
companionRules.suppression: NEW adopt AC5/AC6 same-body full-suppression for only these three profiles: operative whole-body suppression triggered by intersection of any actual occupied part preserves body,HP,position,real cargo,Null state and original deadlines. Speed0,no actions,commands,senses supplied by the spell or intrinsic gear function; no pulses. Clocks and gravity continue, so unsupported actual body Falls. Leaving suppression resumes surviving permissions only, never missed commands or healing. Narrow rider-only suppression affects only its named component. Shade child concentration has its separate stricter ending rule below. No Knight disappearance or Soul Wraith ending rule is silently imported.

rules.identityChoice: NEW director selection: the source champion is represented by one finite temporary champion manifestation of the actual chosen faction, not transported,copied,commandeered or injured as a real NPC. This explicitly extends the lower Champion interpretation for this rank8 spell; the rank8 wording is not claimed to already decide it. It preserves champion aid through one stronger complete martial representative while avoiding unprinted teleport/identity/inventory permissions. No new faction,real champion name,private memories,secrets,official rank,negotiating power,credential or soul is created. Actual faction and champion-designation evidence is still required; missing identity/content keeps the whole positive campaign case held.
rules.gate: NEW reuse exact AC5 institutional gate for one known canonical factionId: actual spell-specific alliedStatus=true,standing>0,invocationPermission=true,no explicit aid prohibition. Also require actual documented champion designation and permission to represent that champion; no assumed NPC sheet is needed for the fixed profile but the identity/designation itself cannot be invented. Declare the known faction/designation and profile before ordinary payment,or at Ready release. Membership,alignment,positive standing alone or other Faction spells do not substitute. Known failure rejects before payment; hidden failure after lawful commitment spends the cast without identifying the hidden fact or choosing a new faction. Missing factual evidence holds the entire success branch.

Its armor,shield and weapon are integral appearance providing AC19/this attack only,not separate equipment,proficiencies,attunements or loot. One Paragon per caster across factions; concentration60seconds and the shared companion/Null/healing/suppression rules apply. procedure.procedure:
KEEP Action,120ft,V/S/F,rank7/base17RP, immunity to EFFECTS from creatures with actual negative faction reputation. NEW one perceived willing creature including self,60elapsed seconds without concentration. Before commitment choose ONE exact canonical faction the caster has an actual recorded source or explicit Director campaign invocation permission to invoke, following closed Faction Seal. No permission means no eligible choice; a positive standing, membership, temporary affiliation, reputation skill or named faction alone grants no permission. Missing canonical faction/permission/standing records retain a whole positive-case qualification; a constructed fixture permission is explicitly NEW finite Director premise, never recovered campaign history.
NEW assess current actual standing-v1 (-3,-2,-1 only) privately at each new application/continuing expression event. Zero/positive does not match; missing is unknown, not negative. Prevent direct damage, spell/technique conditions, forced movement, direct hostile OR beneficial healing/buffs and current attached expression whose actual responsible creature has that negative standing. Do not reduce scope to damage. Ordinary attacks/actions remain paid; missing application makes no damage root or diagnostic. Existing ongoing attached expression is suppressed with original source record/clock, not cured. Current standing or responsible-source change can resume only still-live expression; prior completed damage, healing, injury, displaced bodies, consumed inventory and destroyed stock remain.
Responsibility is source-qualified, not unlimited ancestry: a genuinely new creature attack/operated device uses its actual current actor/dealer/controller under its own source. An ongoing spell/attached projectile component retains its immutable generating caster/root; an allied carrier or proxy does not launder it. A source whose actual rule genuinely transfers operation/ownership follows that exact contract prospectively; it does not rewrite original spell creator or historical root. A creature-created independently acting companion own new attack is that actual creature source, not automatically its distant summoner reputation; a direct commanded puppet/device component retains its real sourced dealer/controller. No generic conversion is inferred from names.
The causal boundary ends at a completed independent physical consequence: real unsupported Falling after a support is destroyed, ambient ordinary flame already genuinely ignited under its source and later unrelated structure collapse remain real and are not recursively immune because some earlier actor had negative standing. Prevent a direct forced movement only when it is that creature direct current effect; do not undo displacement already completed. Direct ward-anchor termination is separately addressable and is not a new effect application on the creature, under the same narrowly explicit anchor distinction as Arcane Aegis. Native mandatory endings/removal and exact terminal travel contracts remain. Current hostility/standing changes never alter past outcomes or disclose scores. Suppression and expiry use the original deadline; source death alone does not end this nonconcentration ward. The ward grants no faction membership, law, authority, alliance, standing changes or institutional protection.

procedure.casting: KEEP Action,120feet,V/S/F,rank7/base17RP and exactly86400elapsed seconds from successful formation without concentration. Choose a perceived exact pose of this fixed structure. The whole union/formation volume must fit in actual range/LoE, unoccupied space and declared support; known impossibility rejects before payment. Hidden changed conditions defeat the paid formation atomically, no relocated substitute. No support is invented to legalize an overhang.
procedure.faction: NEW require one exact canonical named faction, an actual current affiliation record for this caster, and explicit source-qualified permission to invoke this particular faction structure. This is a selected Citadel gate, not an unspoken Faction Army positive-standing aid requirement. Missing affiliation/permission is a whole positive-case hold. A finite NEW Director fixture can state those records conditionally, never claim recovered campaign credentials. Formation grants no standing, sovereign recognition, staff, army, ward, jurisdiction, HQ or membership. Physical doors obey ordinary reach/swept clearance/latch conditions; enemies can use an open door. Later reputation/affiliation changes do not expel occupants or reveal private scores.
procedure.geometry_and_access: Use only the exact closed-box/CSG profile and stable indexed components. Ground room clear height is10feet between z1 and11; upper room clear height is10feet between z12 and22. Stairs have the declared real slope/treads and open upper stairwell; ordinary movement/Load/squeezing apply. No secret rooms, remote storage, extra tower, trap, lighting, furnaces, beds or detached furnishing stock is created. Windows are genuine holes and can admit weather/attacks; actual full-body fit still governs entry.
procedure.site_and_work: The actual wall/roof/floor can satisfy only a demonstrated physical shelter/site component. Safety, comfort, ventilation/weather exposure, tools, food, water, fuel, light, beds, skilled workers, rest time, threats, lawful permission and every expedition/crafting/research predicate remain separately sourced. No completed rest, Haven status, research bonus, recipe, wages or abstract Supply is granted by waiting inside.
procedure.lifecycle: NEW one live Citadel per caster. A successful paid replacement ends that caster old structure without transferring occupants or copying cargo. Nonconcentration caster death/absence or changed affiliation alone does not end it. Original86400second deadline, genuine eligible termination or actual source-specific destruction still controls. There is no new remote voluntary recall permission. Retain each component destruction/HP/pose history and actual occupant/cargo custody; suppression is not repair or new formation.
procedure.suppression: Actual local magical suppression removes only intersecting structure expression under its exact source contract. Mark the genuine affected component portions unavailable; no completed damage or detached external gear is erased. Loss of a real supporting floor begins ordinary Falling immediately with its original fixed end-of-initiating-slot-next-round Fall Marker; no safe teleport/hover or immediate-impact shortcut is granted. On resumption an occupied component volume does not crush, push or materialize inside a real body/object: retain that conflicted component portion unavailable until legal clear re-expression, under this explicit NEW no-crush local return rule. Other portions and original timers do not reset. A damaged/ended component cannot resume.
procedure.ending: At deadline/end remove all remaining conjured components, door/stair/roof/fixtures, leaving every actual occupant and independently supplied external object at its actual current identity/position/custody. Apply real support/Falling and item-placement rules, not a free return to ground. No conjured stone, ash, detachable fixtures, permanent harvested building stock or duplicated furnishings survive. External dropped ropes, tools, containers and damaged cargo remain genuinely external and conserved.
